name: Moonsea
canonical_art_style: Detailed naturalistic fantasy illustration with a restrained painterly finish. Use believable adult anatomy and dimensional facial planes, with expressive eyes proportionate to the face and the character's species. Model forms through gradual light and shadow, subtle warm and cool skin variation, and natural highlights. Distinguish skin, hair, woven cloth, leather, metal and gemstones through their construction, texture and response to light. Keep detail legible at full-body and scene scale, with controlled edges and consistent visual density. Avoid flat cel-shaded regions, heavy contour outlines, plastic skin and oversized anime eyes. Preserve each character's authored age, species and distinctive features. Lighting direction, pose, framing and background come from the task.
